content:
Tom sails from 1 PM to 4 PM, which is a duration of 3 hours. At a speed of 10 miles per hour, the distance he covers is:

\[
\text{Distance} = 10 \text{ mph} \times 3 \text{ hours} = 30 \text{ miles}
\]

On the return trip, he travels at 6 mph over the same 30-mile distance. The time required is:

\[
\text{Time} = \frac{30 \text{ miles}}{6 \text{ mph}} = 5 \text{ hours}
\]

Answer: 5 hours
